description: This header file declares interfaces for ucode-based utilities used within hostapd, including VM creation, script execution, registry management, and utility functions like printf and sha1.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Creates a new ucode VM instance for script execution.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Executes a ucode script given its filename or script string.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a ucode function call by name.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Calls a ucode function with a specified number of arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a ucode VM.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes a global variable/resource in the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the registry at a specified position.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry at a given index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the registry at a given index.

methods.name: uc_wpa_udebug_set
methods.description: Sets debug parameters for ucode VM.
